newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyocera says delays launch of new PHS phone.
newsitem.headline: Kyocera says delays launch of new PHS phone.

text.p: Kyocera Corp said it had postponed the launch of its new Personal Handyphone System (PHS) phone due to a technical problem.
The phone was originally scheduled to be launched on January 20, but a company spokesman said the software had to be rewritten to enable it to transmit text data.
The new phone, Datascope DS-110, will be the first PHS phone able to be used to exchange electronic mail and other text data, the spokesman said.
The spokeman said he did not when the company would launch the phone.
